name: get_root_cause_ranking
description: Reads the verified investigation result identified by investigation_id from durable API storage and returns its top-k candidates. Never accepts caller-supplied candidates or scores.

investigation_id.description: Opaque investigation ID returned by POST /api/incidents/{id}/investigations.

top_k.description: Maximum number of candidates to return (default 3).

name: get_fault_reference
description: Returns AI-curated general background (role, common causes, symptoms) for a signal's subsystem (e.g. 'RF Load', 'TCP Top Pwr'). Not a verified equipment manual; always includes a disclaimer. Returns found=false for unknown signals rather than fabricating an answer.

variable_name.description: A signal name returned by get_root_cause_ranking's candidates[].signal field.
